summary: Iter 8 e2e testing — Partial split of server.py into routers/reports.py, 6 new PDF reports (rendimento, affitti, vendite, lavori, cashflow, mutui), rendimento now supports xlsx/csv, Dashboard 'Ricavi vs Costi' override from bank movements. 25/25 new backend pytest passing + 16/16 iter7 regression tests still passing (41/41 total). Frontend /report verified: all 8 report cards present with NO 'Mockup' badge; PDF download from new endpoints (affitti, cashflow, mutui) confirmed working in browser via real download trigger.

issues: Recharts warning width(-1)/height(-1) reappears when chart container is briefly hidden during route transition — same cosmetic issue noted in iter7, no functional impact

critical_code_review_comments: server.py reduced from 1483 → 1269 lines (~14% reduction). Still above the 700-line guideline. Suggest continuing the split with imports/ and properties/ routers in next iteration (the agent context note already mentions this is rinviato — confirming it is a valid next step).
routers/reports.py uses factory pattern make_reports_router(db, current_user, enrich_property) for dependency injection — clean approach, no circular imports, no hardcoded DB refs.

Order of error checks in /api/report/{id}.{fmt}: format validation runs BEFORE report_id lookup (same as iter7). patrimonio.xml → 400 'Formato non supportato', unknown.pdf → 404. Per spec — works correctly.

Dashboard chart-ricavi-costi override: bankCashflow check requires ≥2 distinct months of bank movements; couldn't end-to-end validate the override during this test run because seed data only has 0 movements for ceo@controlroom.it (same as iter7). Backend /api/import/banca/cashflow-mensile endpoint returns valid empty structure — the wiring is correct, the fallback ('Ultimi 12 mesi · dati demo') is what's shown. To validate the override visually, main agent should seed ≥2 months of movimenti bancari via POST /api/import/banca/commit.
Test scripts had REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL fallback added to avoid NoneType crash when env var not present during pytest run (env vars from frontend/.env aren't auto-loaded in backend pytest context).

success_rate.frontend: 100% (8/8 report cards present, no mockup badges, PDF downloads triggered successfully for affitti/cashflow/mutui)

seed_data_creation: None — no DB writes during this test. Pre-seeded data only.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter 8 fully verified. The 6 new PDF report endpoints all return valid PDFs (>1KB, %PDF magic). The partial split (server.py 1483→1269 lines) did NOT break any pre-existing endpoint (auth, properties, deals, watchlists, import, AI chat, bilanci storico, cashflow-mensile, patrimonio.xlsx/csv all verified). Dashboard chart bankCashflow override cannot be visually validated until bank movements are seeded across ≥2 months. Next-iter splitting candidates (per main agent's note): imports/ router and properties/ router.
